title: SLD (Slide)
body: Supports joint comfort, flexibility and the skeletal system. Turmeric and ginger ease stiffness; licorice calms muscle tension. Standard tier R860. Dissolve one lozenge in the mouth. Full benefit builds over 3 to 6 months.

title: RLX (Relax)
body: Supports calm, restful sleep and stress management. Chamomile and passionflower calm the nervous system; banana's magnesium supports muscle relaxation. Standard tier R860.

title: NRM (Normal)
body: Supports the body's natural blood-sugar metabolism within a healthy range. Never a replacement for prescribed medication; doctor first. Standard tier R860.

title: Objection: 'Will I feel results right away?'
body: Some people notice an early difference, especially with energy and focus products, but the full benefit builds over 3 to 6 months of consistent use, so don't judge it too early. Does that make sense?

title: Objection: 'Can this replace my medication?'
body: No. It is a complementary tool alongside a healthy lifestyle and any treatment your doctor prescribes. Please keep taking what your doctor has given you exactly as instructed.

title: Opening line: first conversation
body: What would you like help with today? Tell me in your own words, and take your time.

title: Customer story · pending consent

title: Flagged by compliance check
